mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% in 1 month and UNRATE > 6%
failure_condition: If HOUST declines by more than 10% and UNRATE is above 6%, but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 300k in 1 month and UNRATE < 4%
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300k and UNRATE is below 4%, but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in a month signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 25bps and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 1% annualized, it signals a deflationary recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and CPIAUCSL < 1% annualized
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is negative for 2 quarters and CPIAUCSL is below 1% annualized, but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
